answer: At each epoch, an agent locks bonded stake and evaluates a committed identity polynomial, proving membership through a Semaphore zero-knowledge tree. RLN permits one rate-limited message per epoch; duplicate messaging produces two polynomial evaluations whose shared nonce reconstructs the private key through Shamir secret sharing. The protocol then reveals that key and atomically slashes the collateral, regardless of whether the payload is tagged violet, wharf, or timber.
